Detailed Description

Class Representing Binary Table Extensions. Contains columns with scalar or vector row entries.

BinTable (re)implements functions prescribed in the Table abstract class. The implementations allow the calling of cfitsio specialized routines for BinTable header construction.

All of the constructors are protected to disallow direct instantiation. Instantiation of the concrete HDU types must be done through an HDUCreator factory instance. This disallows the creation of 'orphaned' HDU objects since the HDUCreator class requires a fitsfile pointer.
